method: Agent inspection of actual native physical framebuffer captures; pixel equality and source/media binding are separate checks, and this is not a human novice study

criteria.clarity: Top-aligned recognizable desktop identities, distinct selection/focus and exact snap proposal labels
criteria.convenience: Single-click selects, direct caption/window-menu actions, keyboard recovery and independent normal bounds remain usable
criteria.user_friendliness: Dirty work survives movement and switching; destructive close remains explicit and owner-bound
criteria.appearance: Original folded-light wallpaper, reduced desktop clutter, restrained active/inactive hairlines and the shared native licensed font/icon system
criteria.readability: Normal and Paper labels have measured contrast-safe backings; dark and high-contrast frames remain legible; compact and scaled physical captures accompany the native tasks

limits: Named display/profile inspection is separate from universal hardware or GPU 3D qualification
Host observation timings in the cached-move report are not FPS or M13.9 latency qualification
Agent review is separate from actual novice-user research
